game.name: Blue Dragon (Europe)(En,De,Es)(Disc 1)
game.desc: Blue Dragon is a role-playing game for Xbox 360. You play as Shu, a young, mischievous and adventurous hero, and his small troop, including a magician, a healer and a pirate. All of them travel through a universe infested with monsters that you will have to destroy to continue your quest. Don't hesitate to level up to make your characters even stronger.
